connectionParameters.label: Base URL
connectionParameters.name: base_url
connectionParameters.desc: Skybox Security server base URL (e.g., https://skybox.example.com)

desc: Skybox Security Threat Management integration allows you to retrieve threat alerts, vulnerabilities, exposed assets, network access rules, and security policy violations. It also supports attack simulations, asset risk scoring, threat intelligence lookups, firewall IP blocking, and change request management to automate threat response and network security workflows.

functions.label: Get Threat Alerts
functions.name: get_threat_alerts
functions.desc: Retrieve threat alerts from Skybox Security filtered by severity and limit

inParameters.label: Severity
inParameters.name: severity
inParameters.desc: Filter alerts by severity level (e.g., HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW)

inParameters.label: Limit
inParameters.name: limit
inParameters.desc: Maximum number of alerts to retrieve (default: 100)

outParameters.label: Results
outParameters.name: results
outParameters.desc: List of threat alerts returned from Skybox Security

functions.label: Get Vulnerabilities
functions.name: get_vulnerabilities
functions.desc: Retrieve vulnerability details from Skybox Security optionally filtered by asset IP and severity

inParameters.label: Asset IP
inParameters.name: asset_ip
inParameters.desc: IP address of the asset to filter vulnerabilities for

inParameters.label: Severity
inParameters.name: severity
inParameters.desc: Filter vulnerabilities by severity level (e.g., CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW)

inParameters.label: Limit
inParameters.name: limit
inParameters.desc: Maximum number of vulnerabilities to retrieve (default: 100)

outParameters.label: Results
outParameters.name: results
outParameters.desc: List of vulnerabilities returned from Skybox Security

functions.label: Get Exposed Vulnerabilities
functions.name: get_exposed_vulnerabilities
functions.desc: Retrieve vulnerabilities that are exposed or exploitable based on network access for a specific asset

inParameters.label: Asset IP
inParameters.name: asset_ip
inParameters.desc: IP address of the asset to check for exposed vulnerabilities

inParameters.label: Limit
inParameters.name: limit
inParameters.desc: Maximum number of exposed vulnerabilities to retrieve (default: 100)

outParameters.label: Results
outParameters.name: results
outParameters.desc: List of exposed vulnerabilities for the specified asset

functions.label: Get Network Access Rules
functions.name: get_network_access_rules
functions.desc: Retrieve firewall and network access rules from Skybox Security filtered by firewall name, source IP, or destination IP

inParameters.label: Firewall Name
inParameters.name: firewall_name
inParameters.desc: Name of the firewall to retrieve rules for

inParameters.label: Source IP
inParameters.name: source_ip
inParameters.desc: Source IP address to filter network access rules

inParameters.label: Destination IP
inParameters.name: destination_ip
inParameters.desc: Destination IP address to filter network access rules

outParameters.label: Results
outParameters.name: results
outParameters.desc: List of network access rules matching the specified filters

functions.label: Run Attack Simulation
functions.name: run_attack_simulation
functions.desc: Simulate an attack path to determine if a source IP can reach a destination IP through the network

inParameters.label: Source IP
inParameters.name: source_ip
inParameters.desc: Source IP address for the attack simulation

inParameters.label: Destination IP
inParameters.name: destination_ip
inParameters.desc: Destination IP address for the attack simulation

inParameters.label: Port
inParameters.name: port
inParameters.desc: Target port number for the simulation

inParameters.label: Protocol
inParameters.name: protocol
inParameters.desc: Network protocol for the simulation (default: TCP)

outParameters.label: Results
outParameters.name: results
outParameters.desc: Attack simulation results including reachability and attack path details

functions.label: Get Security Policy Violations
functions.name: get_security_policy_violations
functions.desc: Retrieve security policy violations from Skybox Security filtered by policy name and severity

inParameters.label: Policy Name
inParameters.name: policy_name
inParameters.desc: Name of the security policy to filter violations for

inParameters.label: Severity
inParameters.name: severity
inParameters.desc: Filter violations by severity level (e.g., HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW)

inParameters.label: Limit
inParameters.name: limit
inParameters.desc: Maximum number of violations to retrieve (default: 100)

outParameters.label: Results
outParameters.name: results
outParameters.desc: List of security policy violations returned from Skybox Security

functions.label: Get Asset Risk Score
functions.name: get_asset_risk_score
functions.desc: Retrieve the risk score for a specific asset based on its IP address

inParameters.label: Asset IP
inParameters.name: asset_ip
inParameters.desc: IP address of the asset to retrieve the risk score for

outParameters.label: Results
outParameters.name: results
outParameters.desc: Risk score and risk level details for the specified asset

functions.label: Get Threat Intelligence
functions.name: get_threat_intelligence
functions.desc: Retrieve threat intelligence data for a specific indicator such as an IP address, CVE, or hostname

inParameters.label: Indicator
inParameters.name: indicator
inParameters.desc: The threat indicator to look up (e.g., IP address, CVE ID, or hostname)

inParameters.label: Indicator Type
inParameters.name: indicator_type
inParameters.desc: Type of the indicator: ip, cve, or hostname

outParameters.label: Results
outParameters.name: results
outParameters.desc: Threat intelligence details for the specified indicator

functions.label: Block IP on Firewall
functions.name: block_ip_on_firewall
functions.desc: Block a specific IP address on a target firewall via Skybox Security change management

inParameters.label: Firewall Name
inParameters.name: firewall_name
inParameters.desc: Name of the firewall on which the IP should be blocked

inParameters.label: IP to Block
inParameters.name: ip_to_block
inParameters.desc: IP address to block on the specified firewall

inParameters.label: Reason
inParameters.name: reason
inParameters.desc: Reason for blocking the IP address (default: Blocked via Securonix SOAR)

outParameters.label: Results
outParameters.name: results
outParameters.desc: Confirmation and details of the IP block action

functions.label: Get Change Requests
functions.name: get_change_requests
functions.desc: Retrieve firewall change requests from Skybox Security filtered by status

inParameters.label: Status
inParameters.name: status
inParameters.desc: Filter change requests by status (e.g., open, closed, pending)

inParameters.label: Limit
inParameters.name: limit
inParameters.desc: Maximum number of change requests to retrieve (default: 100)

outParameters.label: Results
outParameters.name: results
outParameters.desc: List of firewall change requests matching the specified filters
